evidence.notes: Public ApexPages.Message docs and generated tooling expose the component-label constructor argument.
Public ApexPages.Message docs and generated tooling expose the no-render component label accessor.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeApexPagesMessageComponentLabelTest { @isTest static void rows() { ApexPages.Message message = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Summary', 'Detail', 'Trail Field'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, message.getSeverity()); System.assertEquals('Summary', message.getSummary()); System.assertEquals('Detail', message.getDetail()); System.assertEquals('Trail Field', message.getComponentLabel()); } }
